rows.text:
The superhero of Astropolis, armed with the Intelligentsia Guild's most advanced technological achievements, spares no effort to vanquish evil and maintain the city's peace. Over the past five years, he has repeatedly saved the people of Astropolis from disasters big and small.
Some point out that these feats could never be accomplished by one person alone, and that the so-called "Lighthouse" is nothing more than a false idol manufactured by the entertainment-industrial complex. But the public has already poured their hearts into hoping someone will shoulder the burden when they face a crisis. Little do they know, far darker secrets lie hidden beneath the armor of "Lighthouse"...
